## What's free

Stopped registrations in March 2023 and left the domain business in February 2024 (previously free .tk, .ml, .ga, .cf and .gq names)

> Free tiers change without notice. Check <https://www.freenom.com> before relying on this.

## Notes

Excluded: service closed. Freenom stopped after Meta sued it over abuse, and ICANN ended its registrar accreditation in November 2023. By March 2024, 12.6 million of its names no longer resolved.
